mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "house"?
mcq.explanation: بَيْتٌ (bayt) means house.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "hand"?
mcq.explanation: يَدٌ (yad) means hand.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "window"?
mcq.explanation: نَافِذَةٌ (naafidha) means window.

mcq.q: What does hal do at the start of an Arabic question?
options: It makes a yes or no question
mcq.explanation: hal begins a question that can be answered with naʿam or laa.

mcq.q: What is the name of the Arabic letter ض?
mcq.explanation: The letter ض is called Daad.

mcq.q: What is intonation?
options: The rise and fall of the voice when speaking
mcq.explanation: Intonation is how the voice goes up and down.

mcq.q: What is the name of the Arabic letter ص?
mcq.explanation: The letter ص is called Saad.

mcq.q: What is the difference between ف (faa) and ق (qaaf)?
options: faa has two dots above and qaaf has one
faa has one dot above and qaaf has two dots above
mcq.explanation: Only the dots separate these two letters.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence هَذَا رَأْسِي mean?
mcq.explanation: هَذَا رَأْسِي (haadhaa raʾsii) means: This is my head.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word شَعْرٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: شَعْرٌ is read shaʿr and means hair.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "carrots"?
mcq.explanation: جَزَرٌ (jazar) means carrots.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word بَطْنٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: بَطْنٌ is read batn and means stomach.

mcq.q: What does shaping of characters mean?
options: Writing each letter in its correct shape
mcq.explanation: Each letter must have its known shape so the reader can read it.

mcq.q: What is the name of the Arabic letter ق?
mcq.explanation: The letter ق is called qaaf.

mcq.q: What does lii ʿaynaani mean?
mcq.explanation: lii means I have and ʿaynaani means two eyes.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word بَطَاطِسُ (bataatis) mean?
mcq.explanation: بَطَاطِسُ (bataatis) means potatoes.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence أَلْعَبُ يَوْمَ السَّبْتِ mean?
options: I go to school on Monday.
There are seven days in a week.
mcq.explanation: أَلْعَبُ يَوْمَ السَّبْتِ (alʿabu yawma s-sabt) means: I play on Saturday.

mcq.q: Which of these is a masculine noun?
mcq.explanation: kursii is masculine. The other words end in -a and are feminine.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word خِزَانَةٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: خِزَانَةٌ is read khizaana and means cupboard.

mcq.q: What does the mark sukuun (a small circle) show?
options: The letter is silent and not written
mcq.explanation: A sukuun shows that the consonant is read without a vowel.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word عَصِيرٌ (ʿasiir) mean?
mcq.explanation: عَصِيرٌ (ʿasiir) means juice.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word حَدِيقَةٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: حَدِيقَةٌ is read hadiiqa and means garden.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "I have a brother and a sister."
mcq.explanation: عِنْدِي أَخٌ وَأُخْتٌ (ʿindii akh wa ukht) means: I have a brother and a sister.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "I am a pupil (boy)."
mcq.explanation: أَنَا تِلْمِيذٌ (anaa tilmiidh) means: I am a pupil (boy).

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word اُخْرُجْ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: اُخْرُجْ is read ukhruj and means go out.

mcq.q: Which sentence means 'I visit my grandmother on Friday'?
mcq.explanation: azuuru means I visit and jaddatii means my grandmother.

mcq.q: What is the short line ـ used for in Arabic letter tables?
options: It shows where a letter joins to another
mcq.explanation: The line is called a tatweel and shows joining.

mcq.q: What does fii l-matbakhi taawila mean?
options: In the kitchen there is a table.
The book is on the table.
mcq.explanation: fii l-matbakhi means in the kitchen and taawila means a table.

mcq.q: What does maa ajmala l-bii'a mean?
mcq.explanation: maa ajmala is a cry of wonder meaning 'how beautiful'.

mcq.q: What is the name of the Arabic letter و?
mcq.explanation: The letter و is called waaw.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence فِي بَيْتِي مَطْبَخٌ mean?
options: In my house there is a kitchen.
The lamp is above the table.
mcq.explanation: فِي بَيْتِي مَطْبَخٌ (fii baytii matbakh) means: In my house there is a kitchen.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "my turn"?
mcq.explanation: دَوْرِي (dawrii) means my turn.

mcq.q: What does as-samaku ladhiidh mean?
mcq.explanation: samak is fish and ladhiidh means delicious.

mcq.q: What does it mean if a paragraph is coherent?
options: Its sentences fit together and make sense
mcq.explanation: A coherent paragraph has related sentences in a sensible order.

mcq.q: How does a reading circle work?
options: Each learner takes a turn to read aloud
One learner reads for the whole hour
mcq.explanation: In a reading circle each learner reads in turn.

mcq.q: How do you read the syllable نُ?
mcq.explanation: نُ is read nu.

mcq.q: Which sound does the Arabic letter ن make?
mcq.explanation: The letter ن makes the sound n as in net.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence هَذِهِ غُرْفَتِي mean?
options: In the kitchen there is a table.
In the room there is a bed.
mcq.explanation: هَذِهِ غُرْفَتِي (haadhihi ghurfatii) means: This is my room.

mcq.q: Which sound does the Arabic letter ب make?
mcq.explanation: The letter ب makes the sound b as in bag.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word ابْنٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: ابْنٌ is read ibn and means son.

mcq.q: Which style is quick and simple and used for everyday handwriting?
mcq.explanation: Ruqʿah is a short, quick style used in notes and everyday writing.

mcq.q: How do you read the syllable بِ?
mcq.explanation: بِ is read bi.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word ظَهْرٌ (dhahr) mean?
mcq.explanation: ظَهْرٌ (dhahr) means back.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "peace be upon you"?
mcq.explanation: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ (as-salaamu ʿalaykum) means peace be upon you.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "river"?
mcq.explanation: نَهْرٌ (nahr) means river.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "I have two eyes."
mcq.explanation: لِي عَيْنَانِ (lii ʿaynaani) means: I have two eyes.

mcq.q: Which letter begins the word taawila?
mcq.explanation: طَاوِلَةٌ begins with the heavy letter Taa.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word بَابٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: بَابٌ is read baab and means door.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word الثُّلَاثَاءُ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: الثُّلَاثَاءُ is read ath-thulaathaa' and means Tuesday.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence الْبَابُ كَبِيرٌ mean?
mcq.explanation: الْبَابُ كَبِيرٌ (al-baabu kabiir) means: The door is big.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word اُكْتُبْ (uktub) mean?
mcq.explanation: اُكْتُبْ (uktub) means write.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word الثُّلَاثَاءُ (ath-thulaathaa') mean?
mcq.explanation: الثُّلَاثَاءُ (ath-thulaathaa') means Tuesday.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence الْمِصْبَاحُ فَوْقَ الطَّاوِلَةِ mean?
options: The cat is under the bed.
The lamp is above the table.
The book is on the table.
The pen is in the bag.
mcq.explanation: الْمِصْبَاحُ فَوْقَ الطَّاوِلَةِ (al-misbaahu fawqa t-taawila) means: The lamp is above the table.

mcq.q: Which describing word matches yad (hand), which is feminine?
mcq.explanation: yad is feminine, so it takes the describing word ending in -a.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence أَذْهَبُ إِلَى الْمَدْرَسَةِ يَوْمَ الِاثْنَيْنِ mean?
options: I go to school on Monday.
There are seven days in a week.
mcq.explanation: أَذْهَبُ إِلَى الْمَدْرَسَةِ يَوْمَ الِاثْنَيْنِ (adhhabu ilaa l-madrasa yawma l-ithnayn) means: I go to school on Monday.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word تُفَّاحٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: تُفَّاحٌ is read tuffaah and means apples.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word اسْمِي read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: اسْمِي is read ismii and means my name is.

mcq.q: Which word means 'with' in bi-yadii?
mcq.explanation: bi means 'with', so bi-yadii is 'with my hand'.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "Thursday"?
mcq.explanation: الْخَمِيسُ (al-khamiis) means Thursday.

mcq.q: Which Arabic room word is made from the words ghurfa and nawm?
mcq.explanation: ghurfatu n-nawm means 'the room of sleep', which is the bedroom.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word أَنَا read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: أَنَا is read anaa and means I.

mcq.q: What is an inferential question?
options: A question whose answer is stated in the text
A question whose answer is not stated but can be worked out from clues
mcq.explanation: For inferential questions you use clues in the text to work out the answer.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence أُنَظِّفُ أَسْنَانِي mean?
mcq.explanation: أُنَظِّفُ أَسْنَانِي (unadhdhifu asnaanii) means: I clean my teeth.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence أَقْرَأُ كِتَابًا يَوْمَ الْأَحَدِ mean?
options: I help my mother on Saturday.
In the room there is a bed.
I visit my grandmother on Friday.
I read a book on Sunday.
mcq.explanation: أَقْرَأُ كِتَابًا يَوْمَ الْأَحَدِ (aqraʾu kitaaban yawma l-ahad) means: I read a book on Sunday.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word الْجُمُعَةُ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: الْجُمُعَةُ is read al-jumuʿa and means Friday.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word طَاوِلَةٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: طَاوِلَةٌ is read taawila and means table.

mcq.q: What does maadhaa mean?
mcq.explanation: maadhaa means what.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "Thank you for listening."
mcq.explanation: شُكْرًا لِاسْتِمَاعِكُمْ (shukran li-istimaaʿikum) means: Thank you for listening.

mcq.q: Which is the correct blend of the syllables a + bun?
mcq.explanation: The syllables are read in order: a then bun gives abun (father).

mcq.q: How do you read the syllable نِي?
mcq.explanation: نِي is read nii.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word نَهْرٌ (nahr) mean?
mcq.explanation: نَهْرٌ (nahr) means river.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word خُضَارٌ (khudaar) mean?
mcq.explanation: خُضَارٌ (khudaar) means vegetables.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word زَهْرَةٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: زَهْرَةٌ is read zahra and means flower.

mcq.q: Which sentence is a good ending for a paragraph about your room?
mcq.explanation: uhibbu ghurfatii (I like my room) gives a closing feeling.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "My sister is beautiful."
mcq.explanation: أُخْتِي جَمِيلَةٌ (ukhtii jamiila) means: My sister is beautiful.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "garden"?
mcq.explanation: حَدِيقَةٌ (hadiiqa) means garden.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence الْكِتَابُ عَلَى الطَّاوِلَةِ mean?
options: The book is on the table.
The lamp is above the table.
The cat is under the bed.
The pen is in the bag.
mcq.explanation: الْكِتَابُ عَلَى الطَّاوِلَةِ (al-kitaabu ʿalaa t-taawila) means: The book is on the table.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "bread"?
mcq.explanation: خُبْزٌ (khubz) means bread.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word بِيئَةٌ (bii'a) mean?
mcq.explanation: بِيئَةٌ (bii'a) means environment.

mcq.q: How do you ask a boy how old he is?
mcq.explanation: kam means 'how many' and ʿumruka means 'your age', so kam ʿumruka? asks 'How old are you?'.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence أَنَا بِخَيْرٍ، الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ mean?
options: I am well, thanks be to God.
mcq.explanation: أَنَا بِخَيْرٍ، الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ (anaa bi-khayr, al-hamdu lillaah) means: I am well, thanks be to God.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence الْقَلَمُ فِي الْحَقِيبَةِ mean?
options: The pen is in the bag.
The book is on the table.
The cat is under the bed.
The lamp is above the table.
mcq.explanation: الْقَلَمُ فِي الْحَقِيبَةِ (al-qalamu fii l-haqiiba) means: The pen is in the bag.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence الْأَصْدِقَاءُ يَأْكُلُونَ الْكَعْكَةَ mean?
mcq.explanation: الْأَصْدِقَاءُ يَأْكُلُونَ الْكَعْكَةَ (al-asdiqaa'u ya'kuluuna l-kaʿka) means: The friends eat the cake.

mcq.q: What is the name of the Arabic letter م?
mcq.explanation: The letter م is called miim.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "This is my father."
mcq.explanation: هَذَا أَبِي (haadhaa abii) means: This is my father.

mcq.q: What are the three parts of a short speech?
mcq.explanation: A speech opens by greeting, gives the main information and closes by thanking.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word بَيْتٌ (bayt) mean?
mcq.explanation: بَيْتٌ (bayt) means house.

mcq.q: Which sound does the Arabic letter س make?
mcq.explanation: The letter س makes the sound s as in sun.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "And the rain is from the sky."
mcq.explanation: وَالْمَطَرُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ (wal-maTaru mina s-samaa'i) means: And the rain is from the sky.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence فِي الْغُرْفَةِ سَرِيرٌ mean?
options: In the room there is a bed.
In the kitchen there is a table.
mcq.explanation: فِي الْغُرْفَةِ سَرِيرٌ (fii l-ghurfati sariir) means: In the room there is a bed.

mcq.q: Which sound does the Arabic letter ك make?
mcq.explanation: The letter ك makes the sound k as in kite.

mcq.q: What does the word al- do at the start of an Arabic word?
mcq.explanation: al- is the word for 'the', as in al-kitaab, the book.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "at (near, by)"?
mcq.explanation: عِنْدَ (ʿinda) means at (near, by).

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "flower"?
mcq.explanation: زَهْرَةٌ (zahra) means flower.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence هَذَا أَبِي mean?
options: I have a brother and a sister.
mcq.explanation: هَذَا أَبِي (haadhaa abii) means: This is my father.

mcq.q: Which of these is a characteristic of good handwriting?
mcq.explanation: Good handwriting has even spacing, correct shapes and neat presentation.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence هَذَا مَطَرٌ mean?
mcq.explanation: هَذَا مَطَرٌ (haadhaa matar) means: This is rain.

mcq.q: The nuclear family is made of
mcq.explanation: The nuclear family is the smallest family group: parents and their children.

mcq.q: Which sentence means 'I plant a tree'?
mcq.explanation: azraʿu means I plant and shajara means tree.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence أَخِي صَغِيرٌ mean?
options: My grandfather is old (big in age).
mcq.explanation: أَخِي صَغِيرٌ (akhii Sagiir) means: My brother is small.
